title: After School Program Permission Slip Form
subtitle: An original operational permission slip for after school program that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This After School Program Permission Slip Form supports the complete after school program workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the After School Program Permission Slip Form when the assigned after-school site lead needs one fillable record for student arrival, program participation, dismissal change, and authorized release without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: After school permission slip identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this permission slip to one student arrival, program participation, dismissal change, and authorized release record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: After school record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: After school scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: After school requested participation and permission scope
sections.guidance: Separate each requested activity and condition so one choice does not imply another.

blocks.label: After school permission choices
items: Participation in the named after-school schedule
Listed indoor, outdoor, academic, and enrichment activities
Snack participation under the current documented plan
Local movement or transport only when separately described
Use of approved academic or accessibility supports
Emergency contact through supplied guardian routes
Departure only through the documented dismissal plan
Declined optional activities recorded without changing core enrollment
blocks.guidance: Each item is independent; document any exclusion or condition in the scope table.

blocks.label: Permission and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records after-school operations; it does not change a school's dismissal authority, decide custody, diagnose a student, grant blanket consent, or replace emergency services. Stop participation or departure when identity, attendance, guardian direction, authorized release, health support, or safety is unresolved. Limit sensitive information and route decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: After school guardian routing, readiness, and support review
sections.guidance: Confirm contact, release, support, and stop conditions before relying on the permission record.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring review before participation
items: Student expected from school does not arrive
Student arrives but is not on the program roster
Dismissal, transport, pickup, or independent-departure plan changed
Authorized person or guardian direction cannot be confirmed
Required medication, allergy, meal, or support route is unavailable
Student is missing, ill, injured, or in immediate distress
Staffing, room, weather, transport, or school closure changes operations
Attendance, headcount, schedule, or release record does not reconcile

blocks.label: Participation support, limitation, owner, and evidence
Guardian questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

fields.label: Questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

sections.title: After school permission decision and authorization
sections.guidance: Preserve approved, declined, conditional, and unresolved scope as separate decisions.

blocks.label: After school permission decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the school or program administrator, guardian, and qualified health or support reviewer.

blocks.label: Decision rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

fields.label: Rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

sections.title: After school permission exceptions and operating handoff
sections.guidance: Do not force agreement; assign unresolved scope and communicate operating limits.

blocks.label: Permission exception and stop indicators
items: Student arrival or participation cannot be confirmed
Guardian, emergency contact, or dismissal route is incomplete
Health, allergy, medication, snack, or support review is pending
Staffing, room, transport, or school handoff is unresolved
Immediate missing-student, illness, injury, or safety response is active
Departure, attendance, or daily closeout remains unresolved

blocks.label: Exception, immediate control, owner, escalation, and disposition
Approved-scope handoff requirements
items: Approved and declined scope communicated to assigned staff
Conditions and stop points visible at the point of use
Guardian and qualified-review sources linked
Release, transport, or setting limits routed when applicable
Unresolved permission has an owner and due point
Completion evidence and record location identified

sections.title: After school outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: After school closeout controls
items: Final attendance and remaining-student count accepted
Guardian communication and dismissal status recorded
Unresolved incident, academic, or support action has an owner
Equipment and private records returned to approved custody
School, transport, facilities, or health follow-up linked
Program record stored with access and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Permission Slip closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
